start.title: Women and girls: community assessment
start.intro: A short, private set of questions to help decide whether she should be offered a visit to a health facility.
start.privacy: No name, phone number, address or exact age is collected. A case code is created instead.
start.demo: Demonstration only. Use made-up information. The questions and categories are placeholders pending clinical review.
start.forWorker: Ask in a private place, and only when she is comfortable. She can stop at any time.
start.draftFound: An assessment is already in progress (case {{code}}).

consent.title: Her permission
consent.readAloud: Please read this to her in your own words.

points.what: We will ask a few private questions about water contact and how she has been feeling.
points.private: Her answers are kept under a case code, not her name.
points.choice: She can say no, and nothing will be recorded.
points.withdraw: She can change her mind later, and ask for her record to be deleted.

consent.question: Does she agree to the questions?

declined.title: Thank you
declined.body: That is completely fine. She does not have to answer.
declined.nothingRecorded: No answers or details about her were saved.

participant.title: About her
participant.noExactAge: Only an age range is needed. Do not ask for a date of birth.
participant.minorNotice: Take extra care with privacy and involve a trusted adult as local safeguarding guidance requires. Age-specific wording is a placeholder pending safeguarding review.

exposureStep.title: Water contact
exposureStep.intro: Ask about the past few months.
exposureStep.legend: Which of these apply to her?

signalsStep.title: How she has been feeling
signalsStep.intro: Ask gently. She does not have to answer every question.
signalsStep.legend: Has she noticed any of these recently?

contextStep.title: Support and access
contextStep.legend: Anything that makes a visit harder?
contextStep.distress: Does she seem very worried or upset about how she is feeling?
contextStep.distressHint: If yes, a supportive counselling option is offered. This is not an assessment of her mental health.
contextStep.safeContact: Is it safe to follow up with her?
contextStep.safeContactHint: For example, can we visit again without causing her any difficulty?

summary.intro: Check the answers with her. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
